clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken alchemists brew disease near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale. The bottles hold virulent concoctions found at their encampment.

Near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, Forsaken alchemists brew contagions in an outpost beyond the Warsong Outriders' front lines. The bottles give night elves at Forest Song evidence of an offensive aimed at sickening the woodland soil and wildlife instead of meeting their sentinels in open combat.
